observations.body: The LORD’s angel found her by a fountain of water in the wilderness, by the fountain on the way to Shur.
observations.label: Text in view

observations.body: Hagar is found by a spring on the way to Shur.
observations.label: Flight toward Shur

observations.body: A spring becomes the place where Hagar is found and questioned.
observations.label: Wilderness role

payload.posture: Read Genesis 16:5–9 as its own wilderness scene before relating it to other journeys, memories, or visions.
payload.tension: The messenger redirects Hagar, but the scene has not yet resolved the conflict that drove her away.
payload.title: A messenger finds Hagar
